title: Questions for your own documents
description: Search across a personal collection of material, with a jump to the pages the answer rests on. The conclusion can be checked against the original text.

blocks.text: The person is working through a collection of documents and wants to find an answer rather than reread it all. General praise for a tool like this does not prove that a particular conclusion is accurate.

quote.text: If you’ve ever stared at a mountain of PDFs, research papers, meeting notes, or YouTube transcripts and thought, “There has to be a smarter way to make sense of all this,” Google NotebookLM is your answer.

blocks.text: Limit the query to the material selected and show the fragments the answer rests on. Each fragment leads to a page or a place in the document.
If the materials contradict each other, or there is no answer, that has to be shown. A short, confident summary with no way to check it loses the main advantage of working with your own sources.
